description: Authoritative status for ONE mark you already know, by serial number (sn12345678) or registration number (rn1234567). Read-only. Returns JSON with the mark's live/dead status, owner, classes, goods/services, and filing/registration dates. Uses TSDR if a free key is set, otherwise the public Trademark Search record. Use when you have a serial/registration number (e.g. from a screen_trademark hit) and want the authoritative record for that one mark — not for searching by name (use screen_trademark for that).

id.description: Serial like sn98765432 or registration like rn1234567, or a bare number (treated as serial)

name: trademark_status
